assumptions.choice: Dynamically aggregate the single 60m base data feed into 4H and 1D OHLCV series during Strategy.next() to evaluate daily and 4H scores.
assumptions.reason: The execution environment supplies only a single 60-minute data feed to Cerebro without secondary resampled feeds pre-configured.

assumptions.choice: Submit initial bracket orders upon entry and evaluate initial stop-loss, take-profit, trailing stop, and score-flip early exits bar-by-bar in next().
assumptions.reason: Combining fixed initial bracket orders with dynamic trailing stop and multi-timeframe score flip exits ensures exact compliance with risk management rules without order collision.

assumptions.choice: Clamp the sum of 15 component signals (+1 / -1 / 0) to the specified [-10, +10] range.
assumptions.reason: The specification calls for a timeframe score in [-10, +10] derived from summing individual indicator signals.
